fr.elements: Main Building; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Street Frontage; Street Frontage
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Mark all access points with clearly visible address signage so responders can quickly identify entry locations from the street.

• Mark the rear access point with a property address or building identifier so responders approaching from that direction can confirm their location.

• Trim dense vegetation along walkways and drive aisles to keep those paths visible and passable for responders on foot.

• Keep drive aisles clear of parked vehicles and other obstructions to allow emergency vehicles to reach all sides of the building.

• Mark any locked or restricted rear access gates with contact information or a Knox Box to allow responders to reach the limited rear access area without delay.

• Trim vegetation along the street frontages to maintain clear sightlines to building entrances and posted address numbers from the roadway.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Landscaped Island; Vegetation Near Building; Scattered Shrubs; Open Paved Area; Tree Cluster; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim trees and shrubs that are growing close to the building exterior walls.
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the concentration of vegetation near any adjacent structures or access routes.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the landscaped island.
• Keep the paved areas and drive lanes free of vegetation encroachment along their edges.
• Maintain the open paved areas that currently separate vegetation from the building.
